name: Rocky Mountain Mahjong
description: NMJL-rules American Mahjong group offering beginner lessons, mentoring, and weekly open play in Denver.
schedule: Weekly open play in Denver; private and monthly beginner group lessons; financial hardship accommodations available.

name: JCC Denver (Beginning Mahjong)
description: Multi-week beginner Mahjong course at the Jewish Community Center of Denver, covering tiles, passing, and how to read the card.
schedule: Multi-week seasonal course; new sessions start roughly quarterly. Registration required.

name: Mahjong Social Club
description: Dedicated American Mahjong space in Denver offering drop-in open play, beginner classes, guided play, and private lessons.
schedule: Drop-in play $15/2hr session; beginner classes $50; guided play $30; unlimited monthly $100.

name: Mahjong Standard
description: American Mahjong open play series at rotating South Denver Metro bars and restaurants, plus in-home lessons; open play sessions are geared toward players who already know the basics.
schedule: Rotating weekly/biweekly open play sessions ($20-60/session) across South Denver Metro venues; in-home lessons for beginners available separately.
